description: Synthetic 837P/835 sample files aligned to platform matching_837_835 logic

join_predicates.note: Only the segment BEFORE the first dash is matched. Suffixes (ClaimNoLast / ClaimIDLast) are ignored.

join_predicates.edi_837: MAX(EDI_ClaimDetail.ServiceDateFrom) per claim — latest line date (servicedate_837)
join_predicates.edi_835: MAX(COALESCE(STR_TO_DATE(ServiceDate,'%m/%d/%Y'), ServicePeriodStart, ServicePeriodEnd)) per paid claim — latest line date (servicedate_835)
join_predicates.note: Not the 835 check/ERA date. Use the same latest service line date on both sides.

join_predicates.edi_835: SUM(EDI_PaidClaimLines.ChargedAmount) — total billed on the remit, NOT CLP04 paid amount
join_predicates.note: For multi-line claims, CLM02 must equal the sum of all SV1/SVC line charges.

matching_logic.multiple_835_per_837: Each 835 that satisfies all three predicates links to the same id_837. matching_837_835.rn=1 (latest CheckDate) is used for CUSTOM_ALL; get_claim_detail returns all linked 835 rows.
matching_logic.related_837_lookup: Separate from 835 matching: get_claim_detail Related uses ClaimNoFirst + Amount + PrincipalDiagnosis + ServiceDate to find duplicate 837 submissions.
